Maya Chen: quick RFC — planning a tiny docs sprint: fix 3 broken runbook links under /runtime/kv-cache and replace one stale curl example that 404s. will batch as a single PR per file. who can grab review/merge? :raising_hand:
Jordan K: I can pick up 1-2. which files specifically?
Maya Chen: thanks! files I saw: runtime/kv-cache/index.md, runtime/kv-cache/quickstart.md, runbooks/kvcache-debug.md. plus runtime/curl-examples/send-request.sh has a bad URL.
Jordan K: got it. i'll run ripgrep to list anchors: 
```
rg "\(.*#.*\)" content/runtime | sed -n '1,200p'
```
Maya Chen: pretty much — or use the scan results from docs-bot: https://internal/docs-scans/alerts/4321
Maya Chen: replacement plan: convert dead anchors to canonical sections, add frontmatter redirect if needed, and add a tiny note for the curl change.
Leo: quick Q — who is the owner of runbooks/kvcache-debug.md? want to avoid stepping on someone's ongoing edits.
Gabi: that's on me historically, but i'm fine handing it for this small change. assign to me and i'll do the edit+author note.
Rachel: FYI the curl example 404s because the example endpoint moved to /api/v2/send. i'll patch the snippet and add a test curl in the PR.
Jordan K: current plan: Jordan -> edit runtime/kv-cache/*, Gabi -> runbooks/kvcache-debug.md, Rachel -> curl snippet. Maya -> bundle PRs and do canary deploy check.
Maya Chen: perfect. can @Leo do a quick CR on Jordan's PR tomorrow? small edits but need one safety review. also if docs-bot could re-run the scan after PRs that'd be great.
docs-bot: automated scan scheduled: re-run on merge; flagging changed anchors for validation. :white_check_mark:
Leo: yep i can review. ping me when PR posted. :+1:
Maya Chen: posting PRs in ~30m. thanks all! :tada:
